claim: You can launch an instance with encrypted EBS volumes from an unencrypted AMI: when the AMI is backed by unencrypted EBS snapshots, you can encrypt some or all of the volumes during launch.

values.display: encrypt some or all of the volumes
values.spoken: yes, you can encrypt the volumes at launch

evidence.quote: In addition, when you launch an instance from an AMI backed by unencrypted EBS snapshots, you can encrypt some or all of the volumes during launch.
Yes. See technical documentation for details.
evidence.heading: Can I launch an encrypted EBS instance from an unencrypted AMI?

note: Registrar 22: the FAQ answer is a bare 'Yes.', so its evidence names the question heading; the EC2 AMI encryption page states the capability in a full sentence and is evidence item 0.
